focus: correctness: CI, registry, and mirror consumers

findingDetails.title: Script registry advertises retired scripts paths
findingDetails.evidence: Twelve source entries retain scripts/... paths even though those files are absent and registry-loader.sh reads the moved registry as its active catalog.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite registry entry and dependency paths to runtime/cli locations and verify every non-generated entry exists.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct registry read, neighboring loader read, and bounded existence check against the moved source tree.

findingDetails.title: CI workflows install the deleted scripts workspace
findingDetails.evidence: Both workflows unconditionally cd into system-spec-kit/scripts and run npm ci although the old package directory and manifest are absent.
findingDetails.recommendation: Install and build the runtime/cli workspace through the root workspace contract, then remove the deleted scripts-directory install steps.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Direct reads of both workflow setup blocks plus filesystem confirmation that system-spec-kit/scripts/package.json is absent.
